name: USDC-LP (small, expensive)
recommendations: Gas prohibitive: ~$140.00 of round-trip gas swallows nearly all (or more than) the ~$2.47 gross yield. This position is likely not worth opening at this size/horizon.
Breaks even only after the intended horizon: ~1703.3 days are needed to clear gas. Plan to hold at least that long or skip the trade.
Position too small: a principal of at least ~$28,388.89 is needed to clear the gas over this horizon. Size up or batch with other positions.
Negative net yield: after gas the position loses ~$137.53 over the horizon. Do not open as configured.
